description: Named Black Bart and carried on the surviving-F-105 list as on display at AMVETS Post 2256; note that F-105D 61-0138 at Bolling AFB in Washington DC is painted as 59-1771 so the two are routinely confused in secondary sources and the Circleville airframe is the true 59-1771; street address not resolved in this pass and no dated photograph found
